site.title: Culinary Arts Learning Hub
site.motto: Choose Hard. Get 1% Better Every Day.

canvas.note: Instructor: replace the COURSE_ID placeholder in src/content/*/common.json with your real Canvas course URL.

footer.contactText: Reading Muhlenberg Career & Technology Center, Culinary Arts. Contact information is maintained by the instructor in the content files.
footer.accessibilityText: This site aims to meet WCAG 2.2 AA. It supports keyboard navigation, visible focus, screen readers, English and Spanish, and light and dark modes. If you find a barrier, tell Chef O'Connell so it can be fixed.
footer.practiceNotice: Practice progress is stored only in your browser. It is not an official grade record.

quiz.question: Question
quiz.saved: Result saved as practice progress on this device.
quiz.review: Review the lesson and try again. Choosing hard is how skills grow.

lesson.demo: Demonstration content – instructor review required before use as official curriculum.
lesson.exitPlaceholder: Type your answer here (it is not saved or submitted).
lesson.exitNote: Exit tickets are for your own thinking. Submit official work in Canvas.

calc.title: Culinary math calculators
calc.preview: Preview – check results against your own work.
calc.invalid: Enter a number greater than zero.
calc.scaleDesc: Conversion factor = desired yield ÷ original yield. Multiply each ingredient by the factor.
calc.foodCostDesc: Food cost % = plate cost ÷ selling price × 100.
calc.usableExceeds: Usable weight cannot be more than as-purchased weight.

practice.title: My Practice Dashboard
practice.notice: Practice only – not an official grade record.
practice.noticeBody: Everything on this page is stored in this browser on this device only. It is not shared with your teacher, not linked to Canvas, and not a grade. Official grades and assessments are in Canvas. No names or personal information are stored.
practice.none: No practice yet. Start a unit to see results here.
practice.badgesNote: Badges recognize practice effort. They are not instructor-assessed competencies.
practice.resetConfirm: Reset all practice data on this device? This cannot be undone.
practice.goalHelp: Write a goal for this week. It stays in this browser only.
practice.goalPlaceholder: e.g., Score 5/5 on the mother sauces check
